data.title: Yemen Strongly Condemns Houthi Terrorist Attack on Riyadh
data.content:
Aden, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Republic of Yemen condemned in the strongest terms the terrorist attack carried out by the Houthi terrorist militia against a tower in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD) in Riyadh.
    In a statement carried by the Yemeni News Agency (SABA), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates said targeting a civilian economic facility in Riyadh constitutes a blatant attack on the Kingdom's sovereignty and a flagrant violation of international humanitarian law. It held the militia and its backers in Tehran fully responsible for the escalation.
    The ministry stressed that this attack, together with previous attacks on residential neighborhoods and civilian facilities in Yemen and neighboring countries, as well as on commercial vessels in the Red Sea, reflects a consistent pattern of terrorism targeting civilians, regional security, and international trade. It emphasized that the policy of blackmail through missiles and UAVs would not deter the Yemeni state and its partners from continuing their efforts to eliminate this threat.
    The statement reaffirmed Yemen's full solidarity with Saudi Arabia's leadership, government, and people, and its support for the Kingdom's full and legitimate right to take all necessary measures to defend its sovereignty, safeguard its national assets, and protect its citizens and residents in accordance with international law. It stressed that Saudi Arabia's security is an integral part of Yemen's and the region's security.
    -- SPA
